visible_text: Based on the image provided, which of the following inequalities are true for a point (h, k) in the shaded region? (I) k ≥ 3 (II) h - k ≥ -3 (III) 2h + k ≤ 6 A. I only B. II only C. I and II only D. I, II and III
reasoning: The shaded region is bounded by the three lines y=3, y=x+3, and y=6-2x. For any point (h,k) inside this region we have k≥3 (statement I). The inequality k≤h+3 can be rewritten as h−k≥−3 (statement II), and k≤6−2h can be rewritten as 2h+k≤6 (statement III). Hence all three statements are satisfied, so the correct choice is D.
